    How to Use windows_installer_test.bat

    ✏️ Edit this page on GitHub

    #contents

    What Is windows_installer_test.bat?

    This script checks the configuration of a Windows environment in which OpenRTM-aist is installed. It was created to check the installation environment of OpenRTM-aist Version 1.1.2, but it can also be used in environments where an earlier version is installed.
    Simply double-click the script to run it. The results are output to log files, allowing you to check the following information.

    • Check whether OpenRTM-aist is installed
      • If it is installed, the directory structure generated by the tree command is written to a separate file

    • Check the system environment variables

    • Check the Path

    • Check whether OpenRTM-aist-Python and rtshell are installed
      • If they are installed, the directory structure generated by the tree command is written to a separate file
    • Check the custom installation list

    Download

    It can be downloaded from the following location.

    windows_installer_test.bat http://svn.openrtm.org/openrtm-msi-buildtool/trunk/openrtm_msi/test_scripts/windows_installer_test.bat

    Execution

    Double-click the downloaded windows_installer_test.bat file. A Command Prompt window is displayed while the script is running, but it closes when execution is complete. Please wait until it closes.

    Custom Execution (Using Cygwin)

    The installed directory structure is written to a log file using the tree command.
    If the Cygwin tree command is installed in your environment, modify the following setting at the beginning of the script to match your environment. If %CYGWIN_DIR%\bin\tree.exe does not exist, the standard Windows tree command is used.

    When the Cygwin tree command is installed, the yymmdd-hhmmss_'Python directory'-dir.tree log containing the installation directory structures of OpenRTM-aist-Python and rtshell is more compact. This is because the output options allow you to specify how many directory levels to display. The standard Windows tree command does not allow the directory depth to be specified, so the entire structure starting from the top of the Python directory in which OpenRTM-aist-Python is installed is included. Therefore, only directory names are output to the log.

     set CYGWIN_DIR=C:\Cygwin64

    Log Files

    All execution results are output to log files. They are stored in the log folder in the same directory as the script. If the folder does not exist, it is created automatically.
    For example, you can run this script from a USB flash drive and check the results on another PC.

    Log File Name Description
    yymmdd-hhmmss.log Main log file
    yymmdd-hhmmss_pfile.tree This file is output if C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist exists. You can check the OpenRTM-aist directory structure generated by the tree command.
    Even if the 64-bit version of OpenRTM-aist has already been uninstalled, this log file is output if the directory remains because files such as rtc`***.log` still exist.
    yymmdd-hhmmss_pfile_x86.tree This file is output if C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist exists. You can check the OpenRTM-aist directory structure generated by the tree command.
    Even if the 32-bit version of OpenRTM-aist has already been uninstalled, this log file may be output for the same reason as with the 64-bit version.
    yymmdd-hhmmss_'Python directory'-dir.tree This file is output if OpenRTM-aist-Python is installed. You can check the structure of the Python directory in which OpenRTM-aist-Python and rtshell are installed using the tree command.
    If the installation destination is C:\Python27, the log file name will be yymmdd-hhmmss_Python27-dir.tree.

    Output Details

    Main Log File

    Checking the OpenRTM-aist Installation (Checking the Program Files Folders)

    The script checks whether the C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist and C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist directories exist. Even if OpenRTM-aist has already been uninstalled, the directory may remain if files generated after installation, such as rtc***.log, still exist. If a directory is shown as exist! but each of the C++, Python, and Java Examples is shown as not installed, this may be the case. Check the tree file.

    • Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed
      • The following result indicates that only the 32-bit version is installed
      • The directory structure of C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist is saved to log\20160906-141617_pfile_x86.tree
      • The Version 1.1.2 number is obtained from the RTM_ROOT setting
     *-*-*-*-*-*-* check OpenRTM-aist installed directory *-*-*-*-*-*-* 
 [[check]] "C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist" directory 
 --- not exist! 
 
 [[check]] "C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist" directory 
 --- exist! 
 --- RTM_VERSION = 1.1.2 
 
 Result ⇒ log\20160906-141617_pfile_x86.tree 
 --- C++ Examples (1.1.2) ⇒  installed 
 --- Python Examples (1.1.2) ⇒  installed 
 --- Java Examples (1.1.2) ⇒  installed
    • Example output from an environment in which only Version 1.1.1 is installed
     *-*-*-*-*-*-* check OpenRTM-aist installed directory *-*-*-*-*-*-* 
 [[check]] "C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist" directory 
 --- not exist! 
 
 [[check]] "C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist" directory 
 --- exist! 
 --- RTM_VERSION = 1.1 
 
 Result ⇒ log\20160906-133745_pfile_x86.tree 
 --- C++ Examples (1.1) ⇒  installed 
 --- Python Examples (1.1) ⇒  installed 
 --- Java Examples (1.1) ⇒  not installed
    • Example output from a 32-bit OS environment
      • Since the C:\Program Files (x86) path does not exist in this environment, This PC is 32bit OS. is displayed

 [[check]] "C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist" directory 
 --- exist! 
 --- RTM_VERSION = 1.1.2 
 
 Result ⇒ log\20160907-104846_pfile.tree 
 --- C++ Examples (1.1.2) ⇒  installed 
 --- Python Examples (1.1.2) ⇒  installed

 --- This PC is 32bit OS.

    Checking the System Environment Variables

    • Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed

 RTM_BASE=C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\\
 RTM_ROOT=C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1.2\\

 RTM_JAVA_ROOT=C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1.2\\

## Part 2/2

#### Checking the Path

- The paths configured by OpenRTM-aist and the OpenCV settings are extracted
- Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed

    ------* check Path ------* C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1.2\bin\vc12\ C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1.2\omniORB\4.2.1_vc12\bin\x86_win32\ C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1.2\OpenCV2.4.11\x86\vc12\bin\

    
- Example output from an environment in which OpenCV is installed separately
  - You can identify an environment in which OpenCV was installed and added to the Path before OpenRTM-aist was installed

    ------* check Path ------* C:\distribution\opencv3.0.0\build\x86\vc10\bin C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1\bin\ C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1\omniORB\4.1.7_vc10\bin\x86_win32\ C:\Program Files (x86)\OpenRTM-aist\1.1\OpenCV2.4.9\x86\vc10\bin\

    
#### Checking the Installation of Python, OpenRTM-aist-Python, and rtshell

- The path where Python is installed is obtained from the registry, allowing you to check whether OpenRTM-aist-Python and rtshell are installed
- Environments in which multiple versions of Python are installed are also supported
- Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed
  - If `PYTHON_DIR\omniidl.exe` exists, OpenRTM-aist-Python is considered to be installed
  - If `PYTHON_DIR\Lib\site-packages\rtshell` exists, rtshell is considered to be installed

    ------* check Python installed directory ------* C:\Python27\ —-OpenRTM-aist-Python installed.
    C:\Python27\ —-rtshell installed.
    C:\Python27_x64\ —-OpenRTM-aist-Python not installed.
    C:\Python27_x64\ —-rtshell installed.
    C:\Python35_x64\ —-OpenRTM-aist-Python not installed.
    C:\Python35_x64\ —-rtshell not installed.
    C:\Python35\ —-OpenRTM-aist-Python not installed.
    C:\Python35\ —-rtshell not installed.

    
#### Checking the Installation Directories of OpenRTM-aist-Python and rtshell

- Outputs the structure of the Python directory in which OpenRTM-aist-Python is installed.
- Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed
  - The above result indicates that OpenRTM-aist-Python is not installed in `C:\Python27_x64\`, but rtshell is installed. However, this environment is excluded from the check.

    ------* check OpenRTM-aist-Python installed directory ------* Result ⇒ log\20160906-141617_Python27-dir.tree

    
- Example output from an environment in which OpenRTM-aist-Python Version 1.1.0 is installed
  - Since this version supported Python 2.6 and 2.7, separate log files are output for each version if both are installed

    ------* check OpenRTM-aist-Python installed directory ------* Result ⇒ log\20160906-171616_Python26-dir.tree
    Result ⇒ log\20160906-171616_Python27-dir.tree

    
#### Checking the Custom Installation

- You can check the installation status when Custom Installation was selected while running the installer
- This check applies to Version 1.1.2 and later, so it is not output to the log in an environment where only Version 1.1.1 is installed
- Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed
  - If the default Standard installation was selected while running the installer, all modules from [1] through [15] are installed.
However, [12] is not installed when the 64-bit installer is used.
  - When a custom installation is performed, modules that were not selected are not output to the log
  - Modules with dependencies are installed even if they were not selected during the custom installation

    ------* check Custom installed lists ------* [1] C++ : Runtime Environment [2] C++ : Development Environment [3] C++ : Examples RTC [4] C++ : OpenCV RTC [5] OpenCV [6] Python : Examples RTC [7] Java : Runtime Environment [8] Java : Examples RTC [9] Tools : OpenRTP [10] Tools : RTSystemEditorRCP [11] Tools : JRE [12] OpenRTM-aist old Runtime : 1.0.0 [x86 only] [13] OpenRTM-aist old Runtime : 1.1.0 [14] OpenRTM-aist old Runtime : 1.1.1 [15] IDL

    

### tree Files

- These files contain the results of the tree command exactly as they were output
- The `.tree` extension is used only to make these files easier to distinguish from the main log file. Open them with a text editor to check their contents
- Example output from an environment in which Version 1.1.2 is installed

    フォルダー パスの一覧 ボリューム シリアル番号は 9CF9-3755 です C:\PROGRAM FILES (X86)\OPENRTM-AIST ├─1.0.0 │ └─vc9 │ └─bin │ coil.dll : └─1.1.2 ├─bin │ │ cmakeconfgen.py ```
